```lean
theorem lg_target (a b c : ℚ) (h₁ : a + b = 5) (h₂ : b + c = 7) (h₃ : a + c = 6) : a = 2 := by
  have h4 : a + b + c = 5 + 7 := add_assoc a b c ▸ add_right_eq (add_assoc a b c ▸ h₁) h₂
  have h5 : a + b + c = 6 + c := add_assoc a b c ▸ add_right_eq (add_assoc a b c ▸ h₃) h₂
  rw [h4, h5]
  exact congr_arg (fun x => x - c) (eq.trans (add_left_cancel h₂) (add_left_cancel h₃))
```
